_about: Rules for the Product Worker (scripts/product-queue.mjs). Edit freely: nothing here is hard-coded elsewhere. Prices are suggestions; the owner sets the final price.

pricing._about: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: every price must carry its own freight and card fee and still keep the floor margin. Margins here are after freight and the card fee.

freight._about: Air: the forwarder's rate ($9/kg) at the owner's ₦1,550 per $. packaging_factor adds 10% for the box. Sea rate not known yet: sea-only products stay provisional until it is set.

pricing.fx_note: No default exchange rate: each product records the rate it was costed at (source.fx_rate), taken from the 1688 page's naira figure or set by the owner.
